transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I just keep messing up little things. Like, uh... writing the wrong time down on a class sheet over at the senior center. Or I'll measure a board, and still end up cutting it a hair short. Just... skipping over the small print, I guess. That's mainly it.
Are these mistakes causing you any problems or difficulties in your daily activities?

Yeah, I suppose a little. I actually... well, I stepped back from helping lead a couple of DIY workshops recently. Just because of the mix-ups, I guess. 

And, uh... my wife usually has to double-check our plans now. Just to make sure I don't throw off any family visits or the center activities. So... yeah. That's about it.
Do you find yourself forgetting things that happened recently?
No, not really. I mean, I remember what I did yesterday or... you know, what I had for breakfast. My memory's fine, I think.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to learn new things?
No... I don't think so. If I need to figure out how to use a new tool or something, I can do it just fine. I haven't really noticed any changes there.
Do you have trouble paying attention to details or find your mind wandering when you're trying to focus on something?

Yeah, sometimes. Like... when I'm at the senior center. If people are talking at the next table, or... my phone lights up or something. My mind just kind of jumps over there. And then I lose my place in... whatever I was filling out or building. So... yeah, I guess so.
Have you been feeling anxious or stressed about these mistakes you've been making?
No... not really. I wouldn't call it stress. It's just... you know, a little annoying sometimes. But I'm not losing sleep over it or anything.
Do you ever feel like you're in a fog or things aren't as clear as they should be?
No... I wouldn't say that. My head feels fine. Things seem clear enough to me, I guess.
Do you have trouble planning or organizing tasks and activities?

I suppose. If there's a lot on the schedule... like a few errands, an appointment, and I have to get ready for a workshop all on the same day... I guess I don't always line them up right. I'll start one thing, then stop... and end up rushing around at the last minute. But... yeah, I guess so.
Do you find that you get mentally tired more easily than you used to?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I get tired at the end of the day like anybody else, but... no, my mind feels about the same as it always has. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Do you ever find yourself struggling to find the right words when you're trying to express yourself?
No... not really. I mean, sometimes I pause to think of how to say something, but... no more than anyone else, I figure. Words come to me fine.
Do you have trouble making decisions?
No... I don't think so. If a decision needs making, I just make it. I don't usually sit around getting stuck on it.
Do you have trouble following through on instructions or completing tasks without getting distracted?
No, I wouldn't say so. If I have something I need to get done around the house, I just do it. I don't really get sidetracked... it gets done fine.
Do you have trouble breaking down complex tasks into smaller, more manageable steps?

I suppose... sometimes. Like if I have a few things going on the same day. Errands, getting a workshop ready, an appointment... things like that. I guess I have trouble putting them in the right order. I'll start one thing, stop... and then I just end up rushing around at the end. But that's about it.
Have you noticed any decline in your cognitive abilities over the past few months?
No, I haven't. My mind's... it's about the same as it always is. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you have trouble initiating tasks on your own?
No, not really. If something needs doing around the house, I just... get up and do it. I don't have a problem starting things.
Do you have trouble with tasks that require planning, decision-making, and problem-solving?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I just handle things as they come up. I haven't really noticed any big issues with making decisions or figuring stuff out.
Do you have trouble keeping track of multiple tasks or projects at the same time?

I suppose so, sometimes. If I've got a lot on my plate for one day... like a few errands, an appointment, and maybe getting ready for a workshop... I have a little trouble putting it all in order. I'll start one thing, then stop, and... well, I just end up rushing around at the end.
Do you have trouble setting goals or prioritizing tasks for yourself?
Not really. I don't... I don't really set big goals these days anyway. Just take things as they come. I usually know what needs to get done first, so... no, I wouldn't say it's a problem.
Do you ever struggle to speak in grammatically complete sentences?
No, I don't think so. I just... I talk the way I've always talked. People understand me fine.
Do you find yourself easily distracted by your surroundings?

I guess so. Like... down at the senior center. If I'm working on something, you know, filling a paper out or building a project... and folks are talking at the next table. Or if my phone lights up. My mind just sort of... jumps over there. I end up losing my place.
